claims.claim: Japan’s Finance Ministry set the coupon on newly issued 10-year government bonds at 3.1 percent at an October 6 auction, the highest in 30 years, above the 3 percent assumed for the fiscal 2026 budget.
claims.episode_span: set the coupon on newly issued 10-year government bonds at 3.1 percent a year at an auction on October 6
claims.source_title: Japan’s 10-year bond coupon tops budgeted rate in ‘sci-fi’ spike
claims.supporting_quote: The Finance Ministry raised the coupon rate on newly issued 10-year government bonds to 3.1 percent per year, the highest level in 30 years, reflecting the increase in long-term interest rates.

claims.claim: A senior Finance Ministry official said he thought it was something out of science fiction that the coupon would catch the budgeted rate mid-year, and the higher coupon will not immediately impede financing.
claims.episode_span: he had thought it was “something out of science fiction” that the coupon would catch the budgeted rate
claims.source_title: Japan’s 10-year bond coupon tops budgeted rate in ‘sci-fi’ spike
claims.supporting_quote: “I thought it was something out of science fiction that (the coupon rate) would catch up to the budgeted interest rate in the middle of a fiscal year,” the official said.

claims.claim: Investigators identified 18 suspects including 13 naval personnel and arrested Pradeep Mukherjee and Annam Sai Vara Prasad in a probe of an alleged Pakistan-linked espionage network targeting the Eastern Naval Command.
claims.episode_span: identified 18 key suspects, including 13 naval personnel
claims.source_title: How did a Pakistan-linked spy network target Navy’s Eastern Command, and how was it cracked?
claims.supporting_quote: The operation led to the identification of 18 key suspects, including 13 naval personnel spread across 10 States.

claims.claim: Indonesia’s Constitutional Court dismissed a challenge to Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka’s educational eligibility because he had already been sworn in and only candidates can challenge the election result.
claims.episode_span: dismissed a challenge to Vice-President Gibran Rakabuming Raka’s educational eligibility
claims.source_title: Indonesia's VP likely didn't finish high school and it could cost him his job
claims.supporting_quote: The Constitutional Court dismissed the application, saying the matter could no longer be resolved through a presidential election dispute process because Mr Gibran had already been sworn in as Vice-President in October 2024.

claims.claim: President Lee Jae Myung said consumers can check K-brand authenticity with a QR code, and 31 companies including Samyang Foods and Amorepacific have signed up.
claims.episode_span: shoppers can scan a QR code to check whether a K-brand product is authentic, with 31 companies already signed up
claims.source_title: South Korea launches ‘K-brand’ authentication scheme to fight counterfeits
claims.supporting_quote: Thirty-one companies have already signed up for the scheme, including Samyang Foods, the maker of Buldak spicy chicken ramen, and Amorepacific, South Korea’s largest cosmetics company.

claims.claim: China says it is talking to Russia about a suspected plague case linked to Irkutsk.
claims.episode_span: China says it is talking to Russia about a suspected plague case in Irkutsk
claims.source_title: China says it’s talking to Russia on suspected plague case
claims.supporting_quote: Irkutsk is a major hub with frequent flights and rail links to Chinese cities.

claims.claim: The Royal Australian Mint’s Bright Ideas coins go on sale on Thursday, October 8.
claims.episode_span: on sale from Thursday, October 8, in Canberra and at participating newsXpress stores
claims.source_title: Mint unveils new coins chronicling iconic Australian inventions
claims.supporting_quote: The coins will be available from Thursday, October 8, from the Royal Australian Mint in Canberra and participating newsXpress stores around the country.

claims.claim: New Zealand authorities are investigating Hamam al-Hammami, who spent 175 days in New Zealand in flight training until May 2019.
claims.episode_span: Hamam al-Hammami, 29, who police say spent 175 days there in flight training until May 2019
claims.source_title: Flydubai attack investigation widens as alleged hijacker’s training in New Zealand scrutinised
claims.supporting_quote: Hamam al-Hammami spent 175 days in New Zealand until May 2019, as Australian Jewish group calls for full investigation into his time in Melbourne.

claims.claim: Four Indonesian seamen returned on October 6 after more than five months hostage on MT Honour 25; Puntland police said five crew were killed and 16 pirates detained.
claims.episode_span: Four Indonesian seamen arrived in Tangerang on October 6 after more than five months held hostage
claims.source_title: Four Indonesian seamen return home after Somali pirate ordeal
claims.supporting_quote: Four Indonesian seamen who were kidnapped and held hostage by Somali pirates aboard an oil tanker for more than five months arrived back home on Oct 6, an AFP reporter saw.

claims.claim: South Australia’s Attorney-General Kyam Maher says consultation on banning good-character references at sentencing will begin in the coming days, with a bill in the first half of next year.
claims.episode_span: consultation begins in the coming days and a bill should be introduced in the first half of next year
claims.source_title: Criminals banned from using character references under proposed SA law reform
claims.supporting_quote: Attorney-General Kyam Maher says consultation on the reforms would begin in the coming days, with a new bill to be introduced to parliament in the first half of next year.

claims.claim: Nuri’s fifth flight on Wednesday deployed five NEONSAT satellites and nine of ten CubeSats, raising the rocket’s success rate from 75 percent to 80 percent.
claims.source_title: (6th LD) Nuri rocket deploys 5 satellites for S. Korea's first microsatellite constellation
claims.supporting_quote: The mission was Nuri's fifth launch overall and its fourth consecutive success after its maiden flight failed in 2021, raising its overall launch success rate from 75 percent to 80 percent.
